approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the council's 1965 map of the existing boundary or the map of the 1966 Order, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20-25 m); parts of the other town and ward lines are traced from the maps deposited with their Orders (about 20-25 m). They are drawn dotted on the map.
